epics.title: Frontend Image Build Integration
epics.jtbd: When the end customer opens the launched product, I want to see the actual UI, so that I can interact with the system instead of a bare API.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of successful static frontend asset deliveries on the root URL from 0% to 100%.
epics.tocConstraintRef: Deployment Pipeline - Frontend artifacts missing from production Docker image.
requirements: R1: The Dockerfile compiles the frontend directory using npm ci and npm run build during the image build process.
R2: The backend is configured to serve the resulting static output from the root URL.

slices.title: Dockerfile Frontend Build Patch
slices.jtbd: When implementing the Dockerfile frontend build patch for this epic, I want the image to compile and serve static assets, so that the epic's outcome of showing the actual UI is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a fresh clone of the repository
When I build the Docker image and run it locally
Then the image builds successfully including the frontend assets
Given a user accesses the running container on its root URL
When the request is processed
Then the backend serves the built frontend UI instead of a bare API
slices.tocConstraintRef: Image packaging process omitting frontend artifacts.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce missing frontend asset errors on image boot from 100% to 0%.

epics.title: Design Generation Mockup Output Fix
epics.jtbd: When the design shop triggers design generation, I want the output to be an implementable HTML mockup, so that the frontend implementation session has a concrete asset to work against.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the design generation success rate for producing a valid mockup.html from 0% to 100%.
epics.tocConstraintRef: Design-to-Implementation Handover - generator returning un-implementable image messages.
requirements: R1: The design generation configuration or prompt is patched to output a concrete implementable mockup.html instead of a gemini-3.1-flash-image response.

slices.title: Design Generation Configuration Patch
slices.jtbd: When implementing the design generator patch for this epic, I want the generation script to output an implementable mockup.html, so that the epic's outcome of unblocking the design shop is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the design generation process is triggered
When it executes with the patched configuration or prompt
Then the generation succeeds and produces a mockup.html file
Given the generated mockup.html file
When an implementer reviews its contents
Then it contains concrete implementable HTML rather than just an image metadata message
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase HTML mockup generation success rate from 0% to 100%.
